# CoD4 1.7 downloads off retail cod4_lnxded (2026-10-25), derived from three
# cod4_probe captures (docs/research/cod4-handshake.md 11). The raw datagrams
# carry the mod's file bytes and are not committed: each line here is one
# decoded message, `<ms from the first gamestate> s2c msg <n> ...` or the first
# send of a reliable command, `c2s cmd <n> "<text>"` (cp's numbers dropped).
# Server: `+set fs_game mods/modwarfare +set sv_allowDownload 1|0 +set sv_pure 1
# +map mp_crash` under `unshare -rnm` (recipe in section 7), with a stock mod
# holding one iwd of 178745 bytes and a mod.ff of 34310 bytes. Probes:
# `--download auto` (what net::download::missing_files lists: the mod's iwd and
# mod.ff) and `--download main/iw_00,mods/modwarfare/nothere.iwd`.
# systeminfo: sv_referencedIwdNames main/iw_11 mods/modwarfare/z_modwarfare,
# sv_referencedFFNames code_post_gfx_mp mp_crash common_mp mods/modwarfare/mod,
# sv_referencedFFCheckSums 89196 35287381 13517381 34310.
# allow auto
